title: Operation Limits in Dynamics 365 Business Central

facts.text: Maximum file size for upload or download is 350 MB.
Total compressed data size in an environment database is limited to 3 TB including keys, indexes, and BLOB data.
Maximum number of companies per environment is 300.
Maximum OData page size is 20,000 entities per request.
Maximum SOAP message size is 65,536 KB.
Background sessions default maximum wait time is 8 hours before processing.
Maximum nested sessions depth is 14 before an excessive recursion error occurs.
Report default maximum execution time is 6 hours; absolute maximum is 12 hours.
